// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-BANNED-IDENTIFIER
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// A teacher's own words to the safeguarding lead about why they raised a family
// conversation. The model is already CREDENTIAL_NEVER; this is the second lock,
// the one that stops the identifier appearing under the ops roots at all — the
// same treatment `handoverReason` and `requestReason` get, and for a field that
// is more sensitive than either.
export async function raisedReasons() {
  return db.messageThreadShare.findMany({ select: { raisedReason: true } });
}
